## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **Zero Drift**: Exact 1:1 synchronization maintained between `templates/workflows/trigger-review-routine.yml` and `.github/workflows/trigger-review-routine.yml`, and between `templates/prompts/ORCHESTRATION.md` and `.github/prompts/ORCHESTRATION.md`.
- **Repo-Agnostic Purity**: All workflow inputs and triggers rely strictly on repository-agnostic GitHub Actions primitives and variables.
- **English Language Requirement**: All code, comments, documentation, and commit messages conform to English.
- **Bot Safety Guard**: Filter `github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot'` prevents runaway loops from automated bot comments.

### Spec Axis
- **Workflow Dispatch**: Added `workflow_dispatch` with optional `pr_number` input supporting Targeted mode (when provided) and Scan mode (when omitted).
- **Interactive Comment Triggers**: Added `issue_comment` trigger supporting `/review`, `/peer-review`, `/retrigger`, and `/re-review` commands on pull requests.
- **Review Requests**: Added `review_requested` event handling to `pull_request.types`.
- **Concurrency & Guards**: Dynamic resolution of `PR_NUMBER` across PR events, comments, and dispatch inputs.
- **Test Invariants**: Validated via unit and template synchronization tests in `tests/prompts-validation.test.ts`.

### Security Pass
- Permissions properly scoped to least-privilege token permissions (`contents: write`, `issues: write`, `pull-requests: write`, `statuses: write`, `actions: read`).
- Bot comments excluded from re-trigger loop execution.
